title: ULMC Review Metadata Schema
description: Bibliographic/harvest metadata schema. Canonical extraction field definitions live in review/config.yaml and review/EBSCO/VARIABLE_CODEBOOK.md.

richardson_citation_context.description: How was Richardson et al. (2009) cited?

richardson_critique_acknowledged.description: Did authors acknowledge Richardson's critique of ULMC?

richardson_citation_text.description: Exact text where Richardson is cited (for verification)

pls_sem_used.description: PLS-SEM used; captured but excluded from CB-SEM synthesis

mv_inference_criteria_used.description: Authors articulated explicit criteria for inferring MV status

mv_inferred_not_problem.description: Authors conclude MV is not a threat

mv_inference_rationale_text.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim MV inference rationale

authors_business_school.description: At least one author affiliated with a business school or school/college of management. Extraction-time only (not in EBSCO harvest metadata); code from PDF title page.

author_affiliation_detail.description: Verbatim business-school affiliation line(s); semicolon-separated if multiple. Extraction-time only.
